# dp

```text
usage: dp [-h] [--tid] [-d DEPTH] location fmt [args ...]

```

Set a breakpoint that prints a formatted message on each hit.
### Positional arguments

|Positional Argument|Help|
| :--- | :--- |
|location|Function or address to break on.|
|fmt|Printf-style format string.|
|args|Optional printf arguments.|

### Optional arguments

|Short|Long|Help|
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
|-h|--help|show this help message and exit|
||--tid|Include the thread ID in output.|
|-d|--d|Include caller function names up to DEPTH frames deep.|
